annotations.title: Generate Shipley Volume III Past Performance & CPARS Citations

description: Transform unstructured project histories, prior contract summaries, and CPARS excerpts into Shipley Section L/M Past Performance Volume III citations with predicted DoD Source Selection Relevance ('Very Relevant' to 'Not Relevant') and Performance Confidence ratings, Scope/Magnitude/Complexity matrices, FAR 42.1503 5-Factor CPARS narratives, and Context-Challenge-Action-Result (CCAR) blocks. This is a read-only, stateless generative evaluation call where relevance/confidence ratings are model-inferred against Section M criteria (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `rfp_section_l_m_requirements` and `project_history_text` accept up to 100,000 characters, and optional `bidder_role_and_context` calibrates Prime vs. Subcontractor/JV attribution and page budgets). Use this tool when building Volume III Past Performance contract citations and CPARS questionnaires; use `generate_rfp_response` instead for Volume I Technical Approach prose, or `match_key_personnel` for individual staff resumes.

bidder_role_and_context.description: Optional pursuit context specifying Prime vs. Subcontractor citation mix, Joint Venture / SBA Mentor-Protege structure (13 CFR 125.8), or Volume III page-limit constraints.

project_history_text.description: Unstructured prior contract summaries, internal project delivery notes, or official CPARS evaluation excerpts (contract numbers, agencies, dollar values, FTEs, KPIs, and technical accomplishments).

rfp_section_l_m_requirements.description: Target RFP Section L (Volume III Past Performance instructions, recency window, minimum annual/total dollar value, max citations), Section M (relevance evaluation criteria), and Section C/PWS core task areas.

name: generate_cpars_past_performance

gap_mitigation_strategies.description: Shipley narrative mitigations for any recency, dollar-magnitude, or prime-role gaps.

overall_confidence_assessment.description: Predicted DoD Source Selection Performance Confidence rating (e.g., Substantial Confidence).

tailored_citations.description: Shipley Volume III citations with Relevance rating, Scope/Magnitude/Complexity mapping, FAR 42.1503 5-factor CPARS narrative, and CCAR blocks.

title: Generate Shipley Volume III Past Performance & CPARS Citations
